## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

*Sayings-Record of Chán Master Xiàoyǐn Dàxīn* — a four-juan Yuán *yǔlù* of **Xiàoyǐn Dàxīn** 笑隱大訢 (1284–1344), the dominant Yuán-period Chán master of the imperial court (*shì jiào zōng zhǔ* 釋教宗主 "Head of Buddhist Schools") and preface-writer for multiple major Yuán Chán texts (including [KR6q0179](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6q/KR6q0179) *Zhèng dào gē zhù* by [Yǒngshèng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B0%B8%E7%9B%9B)). Compiled by four of his *ménrén* 門人 disciples: [Yánjùn](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%B6%E4%BF%8A), [Huìtán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%85%A7%E6%9B%87), [Zhōngfú](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%B8%AD%E5%AD%9A), [Chóngyù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%B4%87%E8%A3%95).

Four-juan Yuán Chán *yǔlù*, X69 n1367.

Dating: *notBefore* c. 1310; *notAfter* c. 1350.
